_about: The one config of the AMD commands (research/amd). Relative paths are relative to this file. Limits marked not_measured_on_amd were set for a Qwen setup on Nvidia.

gpu_device.name: AMD Instinct MI350X VF
gpu_device.hbm_bandwidth_source: measured on this virtual function on 2026-11-17 with tests/hip_probe.cpp, a plain copy kernel, read plus write; a lower bound, the spec sheet says 8 TB/s

check._speed_repeats: after the answers: each prompt rotated, once with max_tokens=1 (prompt time) and once whole, this many times; min-max is printed

limits._compare_stop: compare where the answers end (lib/compare.py); an assumption not confirmed by the user, false switches it off

quality._about: The fixed quality bar (lib/quality.py): engines may use smaller weights. Measure A from the walk of the judged answers (top-k share, mean gap); measure B from tasks graded by rule, paired with the reference. null = not set; while any limit is not set, ./submit and ./check record both measures and say 'quality bar not set', and PASS or FAIL stays the agreement limit's. The user sets the limits from card measurements (measurements/2026-11-17/NOTES.md, 'Setting the quality bar').

bar._about: min_topk_share: per k, the least share of judged positions whose engine token is in the reference's top k (a k left null is not checked; at least one must be set). max_mean_gap: the most mean gap per walked position, nats. min_task_delta_lb: the least 95% lower bound of (engine - reference) task accuracy, a share (e.g. -0.05 = 5 points).

quality._bar_replaces_agreement: once every limit of the bar is set, the agreement limit (limits.min_agreement) is reported, not applied; false keeps applying both. No effect while the bar is not set.

tasks._about: max_tokens per task answer (math answers end with 'ANSWER: <number>' after a few lines). ./check uses check_file (public, fixed); ./submit gets a fresh draw from the judge (--tasks).

submit._about: Protocol 2: every judged prompt is answered once with max_tokens; those answers are both timed and checked. engine_user runs build and serve on the GPU machine (setup-box.sh makes it).
submit._speed_repeats: the speed in parts from extra requests after the judged ones; they never change the score. 0 switches them off (they add a little over repeats x the time of the judged answers)
